This jar of ‘chill pills’ won’t actually calm you down, but it’ll at least give you something to dramatically toss onto your desk while muttering ‘I need a minute.’ Comes with a side of passive-aggressive satisfaction.

title: Link’s Nap-Time Guardian
tagline: For when you’ve spent too many nights guarding your sleep from the Ganon of snoring partners. This shield pillow isn’t just for cosplay—it’s for those who’ve mastered the art of blocking out the world while still looking like a hero. Perfect for post-quest naps or when you need to shield your face from the morning light after a long night of potion brewing (or wine).

title: Gangsta Vibes for $6
tagline: For when you need to announce your arrival at the neighborhood BBQ with the gravitas of a 90s rap legend, but your budget says 'maybe just a six-pack.' This shirt is the perfect middle ground between 'I’m a menace' and 'I’m here for the potato salad.'

title: Gotta Wash 'Em All
tagline: For the Pokémon trainer who refuses to let their hygiene game evolve. Perfect for that one friend who insists on catching 'em all but still hasn't mastered the art of washing their hands. Now you can scrub away dirt and bacteria while pretending to trap it in a Poké Ball. Just don't expect it to hatch into a clean version of yourself.

title: Literally Rolling in Books
tagline: For the overachiever who insists on both a skateboard collection and a library. These bookends turn your shelves into a half-pipe, because why should your reading material be confined to gravity? Perfect for the grad student who needs to look both intellectual and ready to bail on their thesis at a moment’s notice.

title: Hug Your Face
tagline: For that one party where you want to reenact a sci-fi horror scene, this facehugger mask is oddly perfect. Wear it to a themed dinner and watch your friends question your life choices.

title: Galactic Ice Apocalypse
tagline: Because your whiskey needs a dark side, these Death Star ice cubes will chill your drink and your friends' expectations of a normal evening.

title: Spin Me Right Round
tagline: For when your desk job has you feeling like a human top, but you need to one-up the guy who brought in a fidget spinner. This gyroscopic marvel is the perfect way to annoy your coworkers while pretending you're conducting important physics experiments. Just don't blame us when your cat tries to eat it.

title: Fridge Tetris: Hard Mode
tagline: For the person who insists their fridge door is a 'puzzle waiting to happen.' Perfect for the college student who needs to strategically place their expired milk and questionable leftovers, or the office worker who wants to turn their lunch break into a high-stakes game of 'Will This Fit?'

title: Glass Jellyfish: The Ocean in Your Office
tagline: For when your boss insists on 'aquatic inspiration' but won't spring for a saltwater tank. These glass jellyfish are the perfect way to pretend you're in a marine biology lab while you're actually just staring at spreadsheets. Bonus: they won't sting you when you accidentally touch them during your third coffee of the morning.

title: Regret-Free Ink for the Bride-to-Be
tagline: For when the bride wants to feel rebellious but can't commit to a full sleeve. Perfect for the bachelorette who wants to look like she partied hard but still has to face her conservative aunt at the wedding. Temporary tattoos that say 'I do... for now.'

title: Tree of Secrets
tagline: The perfect ornament for when you suspect your in-laws are plotting something shady. Hang it high, record their 'innocent' conversations, and finally prove they're the ones who ate the last cookie. Just don't forget to charge it before the big family feud.

title: Arc Reactor Knit Mitts
tagline: For when your superhero cosplay needs a cozy upgrade, but you refuse to sacrifice your ability to text. These crocheted wristwarmers let you channel Tony Stark’s genius without the pesky risk of shrapnel or AI rebellions. Perfect for drafting your next big invention while waiting in line at the DMV.

title: Doom Guy's Day Off
tagline: When your desk job has you feeling like you're fighting demons from hell, this Doom action figure is the perfect reminder that at least you're not *actually* fighting demons from hell. Place him on your monitor to silently judge your spreadsheets, or use him as a paperweight to keep your TPS reports in line. Just don't blame him if you start hearing heavy metal riffs during your next Zoom meeting.

title: One Ring to Rule Your LARP
tagline: For when your medieval reenactment group decides to do a 'Tolkien-themed' weekend. Yes, it's $2,500 worth of foam, but at least you'll be the only one who can't be stabbed in the back—literally. Perfect for when your DM insists on a 'Lord of the Rings' crossover campaign and you refuse to half-ass it.

title: Stealth Mode for Your Business
tagline: When you're in the wilderness but still need to answer nature's call without becoming nature's snack, this camo TP is your silent partner in crime. Perfect for that 'I'm not here' moment during a hunting trip or when you're trying to blend in with the bushes during a backyard BBQ. Just don't ask us how it looks in the bowl.

title: Zombie Toddlerzilla: Lawn Ornament
tagline: Neighbors complaining about your garden gnomes? Escalate. Nothing says 'I've given up' like a six-foot-tall, inflatable zombie infant adorning your lawn. Perfect for passive-aggressively hinting that you're not hosting the next neighborhood barbecue. Just inflate and watch property values gently weep.

title: Droid Cupcakes: The Force Awakens
tagline: For when your Jedi-themed birthday party needs more than just blue milk. These R2-D2 cupcake molds turn your kitchen into the Mos Eisley cantina—just without the Wookiee brawls. Perfect for impressing your Star Wars-obsessed coworker who still thinks the prequels are underrated.

title: Witchy Bitchy Halloween
tagline: For the person who wants to channel their inner Winifred but refuses to wear anything less than authentic. Perfect for that one friend who insists on hosting a 'historically accurate' Halloween party where everyone has to bring a cauldron and a copy of *The Craft*. Just don't blame us if your cat starts talking back.

title: Cinema Snob Placemat
tagline: For that one friend who judges you for liking rom-coms, this placemat lets them rate your dinner conversation like a movie, because your anecdotes are apparently that boring.

title: Phaser Your Boredom
tagline: For the friend who yells 'Tea, Earl Grey, hot' at their Alexa, this Star Trek phaser remote is a must. It's perfect for when you need to boldly change the channel from the couch.

title: Sword Ice, No Mercy
tagline: For when you want to serve icy vengeance to your kids on a summer afternoon, this sword popsicle tray is the perfect companion to a backyard battle royale.

title: Birthday Card for the Fossilized
tagline: Perfect for when your grandpa insists he's 'only 65' while struggling to open a jar of pickles. This card comes with a built-in magnifying glass for the recipient to actually read the fine print. Bonus: It doubles as a coaster for their 100-year-old whiskey collection.

title: Your Love Story, But Make It a Choose-Your-Own-Adventure
tagline: Because nothing says 'romantic' like a custom book where you're the hero who forgets anniversaries. Perfect for that couple who met at a cat show and need to immortalize their 'meet-cute'—or at least explain why they have matching his-and-hers litter boxes.

title: Falcon Vanity Alert
tagline: Because your morning routine needs a dash of space smuggler, this Millennium Falcon mirror is perfect for when you're running late and need to make the Kessel Run to work, but still want to check your hair.

title: Jungle Chic for Your Neck
tagline: For when your office cubicle feels too much like a concrete jungle. This moss necklace is the perfect way to signal to your coworkers that you’re one with nature—or at least pretending to be. Ideal for the plant parent who wants to take their greenery on the go, without the commitment of a full potted plant. Just don’t forget to water it, or you’ll be wearing a tiny graveyard.

title: Petal to the Metal
tagline: Because your Instagram grid deserves a floral intervention. Perfect for that one friend who insists on 'vibes' over substance—now they can finally pose in front of something that costs more than their rent. Ideal for weddings where the bride wants to outshine the groom, or a corporate event where the budget for 'ambiance' somehow exceeded the catering.

title: VHS Nostalgia for Your Spotify Playlist
tagline: Because nothing says 'I'm a millennial' like storing your AirPods in a faux-VHS case. Perfect for that moment when you're at a hipster party and someone asks why you still have a VHS player. Just whip out your phone and say, 'I keep my memories in here.'

title: Jedi Snacks or Sith Treats?
tagline: Ever hosted a 'Star Wars' marathon where your guests are more concerned about the quality of your tauntaun steak than the plot? This cookbook is your ticket to serving up Wookiee cookies and Death Star fruitcakes that’ll have even the pickiest protocol droids asking for seconds. Just don’t blame us if your guests start dueling with forks over the last serving of blue milk.

title: Creepy Cinema in a Can
tagline: Perfect for when your midnight snack cravings require a side of existential dread. Plug this in during your 3 AM ramen session, and suddenly that slurping sound becomes a demonic whisper. Ideal for pranking your roommate who insists on sleeping with the lights on.

title: Love in Desperate Times
tagline: For when you've got a crush on your coworker, but HR is watching. These Valentine's Day cards are awkwardly honest, making them perfect for that one weird office romance.

title: Confetti Cannon Balloon
tagline: Because sometimes you need to celebrate like you're at a rave, but your landlord won't let you install a fog machine. Perfect for when your cat finally stops ignoring you, or when you've successfully parallel parked on the first try. Just don't use it indoors unless you enjoy vacuuming for the next week.

title: Alien Carpet Invasion
tagline: For when your gaming den needs a tactical upgrade. Perfect for the retro enthusiast who wants to strategically place their feet on pixelated invaders. Ideal for late-night LAN parties where you can blame your losses on the rug's hypnotic patterns. Just don't expect it to shield you from actual alien attacks.

title: Droid-Approved Coffee Carrier
tagline: When your morning commute feels like a trip to the Death Star, this BB-8 cup is your trusty astromech. Perfect for the office where your coworkers are more Sith Lord than Jedi—just don’t let them steal your cup. Bonus: It won’t roll away mid-sip like a certain someone on Takodana.

title: Pillow Fight Nostalgia
tagline: For when you want to rest your head on a fake Nintendo cartridge, because your childhood memories are literally weighing you down.

title: Party Animal, Literally
tagline: Because who needs a boring rug when you can have a donkey that’s already been through the wringer? Perfect for your post-piñata cleanup or that one friend who insists on bringing their own party vibes. Just remember, this donkey’s seen better days—no need to kick it when it’s down.

title: Lab-Grown Rainbow Lava
tagline: For the friend who insists their home decor is 'minimalist' but also owns a lava lamp. This bismuth crystal cluster is like a unicorn barfed on a chemistry lab—perfect for that one dinner party where everyone's pretending to understand modern art. Just don't ask how it got those colors.

title: Brews and Brains
tagline: When the apocalypse comes, serve your survival group beer from this skull pitcher. It's the perfect accessory for your makeshift bunker's happy hour, because what's the end of the world without a cold brew?

title: Art for the Algorithmically Addicted
tagline: Because staring at your phone all day isn't enough. Now you can immortalize your digital addiction with this painting. Perfect for that friend who still thinks 'Welcome to the Internet' is a profound statement. Hang it in their guest bathroom, right next to the 'Live Laugh Love' sign.

title: Gotham's Power Source
tagline: Because even Batman needs to charge his phone. Slap this sticker on your outlet and pretend you're in a Wayne Enterprises boardroom. Perfect for when your roommate asks why you have a Bat-Signal in your living room. Just say it's for 'emergency calls'—from your phone.

title: Beetlewood: The Hippie’s Heirloom
tagline: For when your vintage VW finally rusts into oblivion, but you refuse to let go. This wooden Beetle is the perfect centerpiece for your '70s-themed meditation room—or the ideal prop for explaining to your grandkids why you still call Uber a 'taxi.' Crafted from actual wood, because even your nostalgia deserves a sustainable upgrade.

title: Glow-Up Your Manicure
tagline: For those nights when you want your nails to outshine your questionable life choices. Perfect for rave enthusiasts who lost their glow sticks and need a backup plan. Also doubles as a subtle way to signal to aliens that you're ready for abduction. Just don't blame us if your cat starts following your hands around the room.

title: Dominate Your Friends
tagline: Ever wanted to judge your friend's 'psycho-pass' at a dinner party? Now you can with this overpriced prop. Perfect for when your book club gets too intense or your Dungeon Master needs a new way to keep players in line. Just don't use it on actual criminals—this thing won't stop a thing.

title: Nerd Cave Sticker Showdown
tagline: For when your dorm room needs a geeky turf war. Slap a Sith Lord on one wall and Voldemort on the other—let your guests debate who’d win in a lightsaber duel while you microwave ramen. Perfect for the fan who can’t decide if they’re more Force-sensitive or a Parselmouth.

title: Timepiece for the Linguistically Inclined
tagline: For the person who thinks a Rolex is too mainstream, this wooden word watch tells time with a vocabulary lesson. Perfect for that one friend who insists on correcting your grammar at parties. Now you can subtly remind them that 'it's' is not the same as 'its'—every 30 minutes.

title: The Split Decision
tagline: For when you can't decide between whiskey and tequila—or when your friend insists on a 'taste test' at 2 AM. This dual-chamber shot glass lets you sample two spirits at once, like a wine snob at a dive bar. Perfect for settling debates over which liquor is 'less awful' or when you're too lazy to rinse the glass between rounds.

title: Tiny Gun, Big Regrets
tagline: When your 'minimalist' phase takes a dark turn, and you realize a gun that fits in your pocket is the ultimate accessory. Perfect for those 'I only brought one bullet' kind of days or when you need to subtly intimidate your yoga instructor. Just remember, it's not a toy—unless you're into that sort of thing.

title: Wash Your Sins with a Burger
tagline: For the person who loves food but hates hygiene, these soap bars shaped like your favorite meals let you pretend you're eating while you scrub. Perfect for the kitchen sink philosopher who debates the meaning of life while washing their hands post-onion chopping. Just don't lick them—unless you're into that sort of thing.
